note: Leaf-green garden hall with a slate-blue tiled floor (cartoon style). Landmark: the big arched garden window with the long bench. On the bench: je (man with a jug pointing at himself), il (man with an eel); back row: tu (girl tooting a whistle, pointing), moi (lady blowing a kiss); front row: me (the cow), lui (boy waving), y (hiker pointing far away); tout (man hauling a towering pile of suitcases at the foot of the stairs). Zoom: the tea-table corner holds ce, ceci, cela, le rien. The open door at the back left goes out to the school yard; the wooden staircase on the right climbs to the first floor. Pronouns have no gender here (divider null).
